summary: Two Major proof-level failures: the prescribed geometric realization and the positive-proportion display (5.5). The dimension count has a verified conditional repair; the full geometric repair and main positivity theorem are not thereby certified.

problems.location: p18Section4.1 choice lambda*, claimed half-length, top-bottom identification; Eq4.2p15 and4.20p19
problems.assumptions: Reverse4 irreducible permutation, genus2, p any prime>=3, n=(1,1,1,1), lambda_hat=(1/3,1/3,1/3), lambda*=(a,a,a,1-3a), a=(p+1)/(6p^2). All positivity, Delta_p, p not dividing n_alpha_t and even stronger p16 length bound satisfied.
problems.decisive_evidence: Last length=(p-1)/(2p), not1/2. Printed bottom coordinate sqrt2(S-1)<0. Even modulo width, u1=2a-e/2,u2=1/2-e/2,e=1/(2p^2), have S(u2)-S(u1)=1/2 and overlapping open image intervals; fails edge pairing for arbitrarily large primes.
problems.core_dependency: X and coverY -> Lemmas4.4-4.6 -> orbit closure -> EKZ/CE inProposition5.2 -> MainTheorem proof
problems.impact: Core stated geometric realization is not defined as claimed, so proof bridge unsupported; no counterexample to positivity itself.
problems.counterevidence: Horizontal modulo interpretation explicitly tested and still noninjective. Candidate s1/2 plus corrected shift may repair; not silently assumed.
problems.correction: Use s*=1/2 and shift -sqrt2/2 as candidate, then verify covering, deck map, singularities and directional return identities.
problems.repair_verification: Algebraic normalization checked; complete geometric repair not established.

problems.decisive_evidence: Printed middle term <=1/(p-1) cannot exceed fixed positive c(g-1)/d for all large p.
problems.impact: The printed estimate cannot give the fixed positive proportion needed in (5.8)-(5.11). This is a core proof step, independently of the geometric defect P1. Its conditional algebraic repair does not downgrade the failure.
problems.correction: m/(p-1)>=1-D/((p-1)(d-1)); use D<=p(d-1)+1-cg*, giving limit c(g-1)/(d-1)>target.
problems.repair_verification: Complete conditional dimension calculation in report and evidence.
problems.severity_basis: Major for a false core positive-proportion derivation; the corrected count is verified only conditional on the earlier geometric and exponent inputs.

limitations: Main positivity theorem not disproved; exact stated geometric proof construction is invalid.

scientific_checks.independent_derivation: Fp gives last return interval length1-s; at s=(p+1)/(2p) this is(p-1)/(2p), not1/2. The actual source image's top-side map has horizontal coordinate sqrt2(S-1)<0, outside the prescribed bottom side. For the reverse4 irreducible permutation the intersection matrix is nonsingular (determinant1), hence genus2. With lambda_hat=(1/3,1/3,1/3), n=(1,1,1,1) and a=(p+1)/(6p^2), all positivity, sum1, terminal-interval and prime-divisibility conditions hold for p>=3; even lambda4>p/(p+1) follows from2p^2>(p+1)^2.
scientific_checks.modulo_counterevidence_test: The constant integer observable makes the stopping map T^p. For e=1/(2p^2), u1=2a-e/2 and u2=1/2-e/2 are interior points with respective branch sequences I2,I4^(p-1) and I4^(p-1),I1. The interval translations give S(u1)=u1+1-s and S(u2)=u2+1-s+2a, so S(u2)-S(u1)=1/2. Thus reducing modulo the square width still creates overlapping open image intervals, not merely identified vertices. At p3 the exact values are13/108,17/36 and49/108,103/108; the algebra works for arbitrarily large primes.
scientific_checks.actual_dependency_and_limits: X and the claimed p-fold coverY supply Lemmas4.4-4.6 and the orbit closure to which the exponent results in Proposition5.2 are applied. This core construction fails; positivity itself is not refuted. Candidate s=1/2 and shift -sqrt2/2 require a full new covering/return-map check that is not claimed.

scientific_checks.independent_derivation: The printed middle expression(1-D/(d-1))/(p-1) is at most1/(p-1) for D>=0 and cannot bound below the fixed positive c(g-1)/d for all large primes. The genuine direct-sum count is(p-1-m)(d-1)<=D, giving m/(p-1)>=1-D/((p-1)(d-1)). Using actual ambient dimension N=p(d-1)+1 and the assumed exponent bound yields D<=N-cg*, hence the lower limit c(g-1)/(d-1)>c(g-1)/d.
scientific_checks.actual_dependency_and_severity: The false display is the positive-proportion input for (5.8), (5.9), (5.10) and the main limit (5.11), so it is a Major core proof error. A complete conditional algebraic repair does not downgrade it.
scientific_checks.counterevidence_and_repair_boundary: The corrected inequality verifies that this counting step is repairable under the geometric and exponent inputs. It does not repair P1 or prove the main theorem independently.
